title: User Login with Correct Credentials
description: Verify that users can successfully log in using valid credentials through Supabase Auth.

steps.description: Navigate to login page
Input a valid email and password
Click the login button
User is authenticated and redirected to dashboard
A valid session token is stored securely

title: User Login with Incorrect Credentials
description: Ensure login fails with invalid email or password, and proper error message is shown.

steps.description: Navigate to login page
Input an invalid email or incorrect password
Click the login button
Login is rejected
An error message indicating invalid credentials is displayed

title: Password Reset Workflow
description: Validate the password reset process, including request email, reset link, and new password submission.

steps.description: Navigate to login page
Click the 'Forgot Password' link
Submit registered email address for password reset
Password reset email is sent
Use reset link to open reset password form
Input and confirm new password
Submit new password
Password is updated and user can log in with new password

title: Google OAuth Integration for User Login
description: Test login via Google OAuth including token generation, redirection, and secure storage of tokens.

steps.description: Navigate to login page
Click 'Login with Google' button
Complete OAuth consent and authorize app access
User is authenticated and redirected to dashboard
OAuth tokens are stored securely in backend

title: Initiate AI Voice Agent Conversation via Live Demo
description: Verify that voice agent starts conversation after customer initiates interaction on Live Demo page.

steps.description: Navigate to Live Demo page
Start voice input or phone call simulation
AI voice agent greets customer with natural voice response
Voice activity detection activates upon speech
Live transcription displays real-time text matching spoken words

title: Book Appointment through AI Voice Agent
description: Test booking an appointment through AI agent flow, including checking calendar availability and sending confirmation.

steps.description: Start conversation with AI voice agent
Request to book appointment for specific date and time
AI agent checks calendar availability via Google Calendar API integration
Confirmation of available slot is communicated to customer
Confirm appointment booking
Booking is saved in database and calendar is updated
Customer receives confirmation via email and SMS

title: Handle Booking Conflict Scenario
description: Verify AI agent properly handles conflict when requested appointment slot is unavailable.

steps.description: Start AI conversation and request a fully booked appointment slot
Agent detects unavailability via calendar sync
Agent offers alternative available time slots
Select alternative slot and confirm
Booking is saved successfully and confirmation is sent

title: Manage Bookings List View and Filtering
description: Validate bookers' ability to view, filter, and update booking statuses in list view.

steps.description: Log in as business owner
Navigate to bookings list page
Bookings are displayed in a paginated list with key details
Apply filters e.g. date range, status, customer name
Bookings list updates according to filters
Update a booking status to 'confirmed' or 'cancelled'
Booking status changes are saved and reflected in calendar view

title: Synchronize Google Calendar with Booking Events
description: Ensure booking events sync bidirectionally with Google Calendar using OAuth integration.

steps.description: Business owner connects Google Calendar via OAuth on integrations page
OAuth access tokens are saved securely
Create a new booking in application
Booking event is created in connected Google Calendar
Create an event directly in Google Calendar
Event appears in application booking calendar within sync interval

title: View and Search Call History and Transcripts
description: Verify that call logs, duration, outcomes, and searchable transcripts are accessible and accurate.

steps.description: Log in as business owner
Navigate to call history page
List of calls is displayed with details: date, duration, status
Select a call to view full transcript and audio playback
Transcript text matches the voice conversation
Search transcripts by keywords or customer name
Search returns relevant call records

title: Analytics Dashboard Data Visualization and Export
description: Test analytics dashboard displays accurate metrics and charts and supports data export functionality.

steps.description: Navigate to analytics dashboard
Dashboard shows bookings, revenue, call performance, and conversion rates
Visual charts update interactively according to date range filters
Click to export analytics data in CSV format
Exported file contains accurate and complete data

title: Business Settings Configuration and Persistence
description: Verify business owner can configure business details, hours, services, pricing and that settings persist.

steps.description: Log in as business owner
Navigate to business settings page
Update business name, operation hours, and service pricing
Save the changes
Changes are saved to backend and visible after page reload

title: Manage Service Offerings with Add/Edit/Delete
description: Ensure that service offerings can be created, modified, and deleted correctly with validations.

steps.description: Navigate to services management page
Add a new service with name, description, duration, and pricing
New service appears in list and reflects correct details
Edit an existing service's pricing and description
Edits are saved and displayed correctly
Delete a service
Service is removed from list and related bookings handled accordingly

title: Twilio Integration for Incoming Customer Calls
description: Verify that incoming calls via Twilio trigger edge functions which create real-time AI sessions appropriately.

steps.description: Initiate an inbound call to the Twilio configured number
Twilio edge function is invoked
Real-time AI session is created and ready for conversation
Call audio streams correctly to AI voice agent

title: Knowledge Base Website Crawling and Summarization
description: Test adding a website to knowledge base, crawling content, summarizing, and saving for AI contextualization.

steps.description: Navigate to knowledge base management page
Add a new website URL for crawling
Trigger content fetch and summarization process
Website content is successfully fetched and summaries generated
Save summarized content to knowledge base
Saved content is available for AI response contextualization

title: Session Handling and Secure Route Protection
description: Validate that protected routes require authentication and enforce session expiration and renewal.

steps.description: Attempt to access a protected route without login
User is redirected to login page
Log in and access protected route
Access is granted
Let session expire and try to access protected resource
User is redirected to login due to session expiration

title: UI Responsiveness on Desktop and Mobile Devices
description: Verify that user interface components and pages render correctly and remain usable on multiple screen sizes.

steps.description: Load application on desktop browser with large resolution
Layout and components render correctly without overlaps
Load application on mobile device viewport or emulator
Responsive navigation, modals, and forms display correctly
All interactive elements remain accessible and usable

title: Error Handling and Loading States Throughout Application
description: Test that the application gracefully handles API failures, loading delays, and displays meaningful feedback.

steps.description: Simulate network failure or server error during API calls
User-facing error messages or alerts are displayed
Perform actions triggering loading states (e.g., saving settings, booking an appointment)
Loading indicators appear until operation completes
Application recovers and permits retry after failure

title: Realtime AI Voice Agent Low-Latency Audio Streaming
description: Confirm that AI voice agent responds with minimal latency during real-time conversations using WebRTC.

steps.description: Initiate real-time voice interaction on Live Demo page
Audio streaming is established with WebRTC
AI responses occur with latency under defined target threshold (e.g., < 1 second)

Configuration dialog opens with title 'Configure OpenAI'
API Key password field is present
Model dropdown shows official model names: gpt-4o, gpt-4o-mini, gpt-4-turbo, etc

Select 'Custom Model...' option
Custom model input field appears
Enter custom model name (e.g., gpt-4o-2024-08-06)
Custom model name is accepted

Toggle Voice Agent ON
Toggle Knowledge Base Summarization ON
Click Save

Gemini API Key field is present

Feature assignment toggles are visible
Toggle Knowledge Base Summarization ON for Gemini
Enter Gemini API key
Click Save

Gemini card status shows 'Connected'

Configuration dialog opens
Model dropdown shows provider/model format: openai/gpt-4o, anthropic/claude-3.5-sonnet, etc

Select 'Custom Model...' and enter custom provider/model
